title: Flexible Latin directed triple systems
summary: It is well known that, given a Steiner triple system, a quasigroup can be formed by defining an operation $\cdot$ by the identities $x \cdot x = x$ and $x \cdot y = z$ where $z$ is the third point in the block containing the pair $\{x,y\}$. The same is true for a Mendelsohn triple system where the pair $(x,y)$ is considered to be ordered. But it is not true in general for directed triple systems. However directed triple systems which form quasigroups under this operation do exist and we call these Latin directed triple systems. The quasigroups associated with Steiner and Mendelsohn triple…
